poetry: Spring sleep, dawn unnoticed; birds sing everywhere.
Pluck chrysanthemums by the hedge; gaze at the south mountain.
Walk to where the stream ends; sit and watch clouds rise.
What's in the hills? Pine brew, spring tea.
Evening, snow in the air — a cup of wine?
Osmanthus falls in quiet; night, empty spring hills.
Moon through pines, clear stream on stone.
Grass sets seed, wind shakes the leaves.
You watch the clouds, then me.
Once, days were slow — carriage, horse, mail.
Dark gave me dark eyes; I use them to seek light.
Facing the sea, spring warm, flowers open.
May you find love; may you find peace in this world.
Tonight I care not for the world; I only think of you.
To live on this earth — sun strong, water gentle.
The plainest life and the farthest dream.
Time spares none; I've not spared time.
Every meeting is a reunion.
Mountains and rivers; the world's smoke and fire.
May you strive and be loved.
Meaning is here; words fail.
Life is a journey; I'm a traveler.
Drunk, I don't know sky from water; boat full of dreams.
Rain all night; tomorrow, apricot blossoms in the lane.
No worries on the mind — the best of seasons.
I see the hills so fair; they see me the same.
Lone bird with sunset; autumn sky and water one.
Straw sandals, light as a horse; one coat, one rain.
The mountain has trees; I have a heart you don't know.
Moon rises on the sea; we share this night.
You ask when I'll return; night rain on Mount Ba.
Spring breeze, proud horse, flowers of Chang'an in a day.
Buy wine, go with the bloom — not like the old days.
Good things don't last; clouds scatter, glass breaks.
You were a draft through the hall; I was the flood.
We'll be lost in the fog and forget each other.
I have a gourd of wine to comfort the dust.
The taste of the world is a light joy.
When did the bright moon first appear?
Long life, a thousand miles, one moon.
Life is like a goose's print on snow.
No branch to perch; cold shore, lonely.
Where is home? The heart at peace is home.
New fire, new tea; wine and youth.
Don't dwell on the past; new fire, new tea.
Spring water bluer than sky; painted boat, rain, sleep.
That moon once shone on her return.
We don't see the old moon; this moon once lit the old.
Clouds part; ten years like water.
We never tire; only Jingting Mountain.
coldKnowledge: Honey doesn't spoil; edible honey was found in Egyptian tombs.
Bananas are berries; strawberries are not.
A cumulus cloud weighs about 500 tons on average.
Octopuses have three hearts and blue blood.
Humans walk about 200,000 km in a lifetime — ~5 times around Earth.
Yawning is contagious; even reading "yawning" can trigger it.
Penguins can jump over a meter to get onto ice.
You're 1–2 cm taller in the morning than at night.
A bee's wings beat about 200 times per second.
Polar bear skin is black; fur is transparent and hollow.
A giraffe's tongue can reach ~45 cm to grab leaves.
Snails can sleep for three years.
Otters hold hands while sleeping so they don't drift apart.
Koala fingerprints can be confused with human ones.
Sloths come down to poop about once a week.
Flamingo pink comes from algae and shrimp they eat.
Owls can't move their eyes; they rotate their heads ~270°.
The human brain is about 75% water.
Light takes about 8 min 20 s from the Sun to Earth.
An average cloud holds about 1 million liters of water.
Ants don't sleep but take two ~8-minute naps per day.
Elephants sense vibrations dozens of km away through their feet.
Goldfish memory can last months, not seconds.
Kangaroos can't jump backward.
Jellyfish have no heart, brain, or bones.
Sharks have been around ~400 million years longer than humans.
Butterflies taste with their feet.
A crocodile's brain is about the size of five Oreos.
Pigeons can recognize their own photo in a mirror.
Starfish have no blood; they use seawater.
Humans shed about 18 kg of skin in a lifetime.
Fingernails grow about 4× faster than toenails.
Humans have about 100,000 dreams in a lifetime.
The heart pumps about 7,600 liters of blood per day.
The eye can distinguish about 10 million colors.
A sneeze can reach ~160 km/h.
Humans produce about 25,000 liters of saliva in a lifetime.
Bone is stronger than steel by weight.
Smell almost turns off during sleep — smoke is dangerous.
There are ~30× more trees on Earth than stars in the Milky Way.
The Moon moves ~3.8 cm away from Earth each year.
Lightning is ~5× hotter than the Sun's surface.
Diamonds can burn at high temperature.
Ice has more than a dozen crystal structures.
Chimborazo is farther from Earth's center than Everest.
~71% of Earth is ocean; we've explored under 5%.
A day isn't exactly 24 hours; Earth's spin is slowing.
Bananas have trace potassium-40; they're still safe.
A single hair can hold ~100 g; a full head can hold ~2 cars.
